senses.gloss:
buddhá, ppl. awakened; illuminé; enlightened;
 --esp., as m. The Enlightened
One, epithet of Gautama of the Śākya
tribe. [√budh: for budh-ta (160), the
formal equivalent of -πυθ-το- in ἄπυστος,
‘not having learned.’]

buddhi-jīvin, a. living by one's mind,
employing one's intelligence, intelligent.
